title: MICo-150K: A Comprehensive Dataset Advancing Multi-Image Composition

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating the ethnic distribution (e.g., East/Southeast Asian, European/Middle Eastern, African) of human-face source images in the dataset using the Qwen2.5-VL-72B vision-language model to identify representational skews.

Estimating the raw gender distribution of human-face source images in the dataset using the Qwen2.5-VL-72B vision-language model to assess upstream imbalances and document enforced gender balancing during task construction.

Estimating the coarse age group distribution (Child, Teen/Young Adult, Middle-Aged, Older Adult) of human-face source images in the dataset using the Qwen2.5-VL-72B vision-language model to identify age representation dominance (e.g., young-adult bias).
